prd_meta.title: volregger PRD
prd_meta.subtitle: Rigid-First Robust fMRI Motion Correction with Optional Slice-Aware Refinement
source_context: Part 2 package architecture and implementation plan

product.name: volregger
product.problem_statement: Retrospective fMRI motion correction should remain rigid-body by default, while addressing known residual error sources (reference bias and intra-volume motion) through robust templateing and optional acquisition-aware refinement.
target_users: research users needing MCFLIRT/3dvolreg-class behavior in R
goals: Deliver a fast and robust 6-DOF default engine competitive in class with MCFLIRT/3dvolreg on retrospective within-run correction.
Provide an optional slice/MB packet-aware refinement path without making the default solver fragile.
Expose QC and failure flags that support downstream censoring and reproducible analysis.
Keep R API small and stable; keep performance-critical operations in coarse-grained C++ kernels.
non_goals: Nonlinear deformation as default motion model.
Embedding spin-history repair inside core rigid optimization.
design_principles: Robust template over single fixed reference.
Robust local-normalized contrast over raw SSD.
Warm-start temporal continuity with small restart safety net.
Separation of concerns: estimate, apply, qc, optional refinements.

rigid_robust: Robust mean-template refresh from aligned frames.
Temporal warm starts and constant-velocity prediction.
Tiny restart set for suspicious/bad fits.
rigid_spline: Fits smooth pose spline over time.
Uses slice/MB packet acquisition offsets in final resampling.
Optional refinement of spline control points in later versions.

public_api.main: volreg(x, mask, ref, ref_index, engine, slice_times, mb_groups, resample, interp_final, qc, control, verbose)
class_and_methods: methods: print, plot, summary, coef, as.data.frame

r_cpp_boundary.policy: Cross R/C++ boundary once for estimate, once for apply, once for metrics. Avoid frame loops in R.
r_cpp_boundary.adapter: R/adapters-neuroim2.R converts neuroim2 object to internal payload and reconstructs output while preserving affine/header.

memory_model: Accept double from R; use float working buffers where safe.

algorithmic_details.objective_v1: Robust local-normalized contrast objective with Huber penalty and composite spatial-temporal-overlap weights.
algorithmic_details.optimizer: Custom LM with analytic Jacobians and SE(3) exponential-map updates.
algorithmic_details.restarts: Triggered only on suspicious fits; small local perturbation set around predicted pose.
interpolation_policy: Final output defaults to cubic B-spline; optional Lanczos; linear for speed/debug.

slice_aware_mode: v1: spline-evaluated pose at slice/MB acquisition offsets for final resampling.
v2: optimize spline control points against packet-level residuals.
spin_history_repair: Separate function: repair_spin_history(x, motion, mask, method='slice_gain').
Estimate slice-wise residual gains and apply temporally smoothed correction on high-confidence events.

mostly_serial: time-ordered rigid estimation with warm starts

requirements.description: Default engine SHALL perform 6-DOF rigid-body estimation across all frames and return nt x 6 motion parameters and 4x4 transforms.
Estimator SHALL support middle-volume initialization and robust mean-template refresh for the main alignment pass.
Estimator SHALL use multi-resolution LM/Gauss-Newton with temporal warm starts and optional constant-velocity initialization.
Cost SHALL be robust local-normalized contrast with Huber-like reweighting and support composite weights M, G, R, O.
Pipeline SHALL perform exactly one final output resampling step unless user explicitly requests otherwise in future advanced APIs.
Package SHALL expose a compact R API: volreg, estimate_motion, apply_motion, motion_qc, framewise_disp, dvars.
Core heavy computation SHALL run in coarse-grained C++ kernels with no per-frame R loops in estimation path.
QC output SHALL include per-frame cost_init, cost_final, iterations, restart flag, overlap, FD, DVARS/robust DVARS, and fit flags.
Engine rigid_spline SHOULD support slice_times/mb_groups for slice/packet-aware final resampling.
Optional spin-history repair SHOULD be available as a separate stage/function, not coupled to rigid solver internals.
Implementation SHALL preserve neuroim2-like affine/header metadata when roundtripping corrected output.
Interpolation options SHOULD include bspline default, lanczos optional, linear debug path; optimization interpolation remains trilinear.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Calling volreg() on valid 4D input returns class volregger_fit with motion matrix nt x 6, transform matrices, and expected fields.
acceptance_criteria.test_hint: Shape/type checks and class contract checks on synthetic dataset.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Estimator uses middle-volume bootstrap and completes outward solve in both temporal directions with warm starts.
acceptance_criteria.test_hint: Inspect trace logs/control hooks to confirm traversal order and init source.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Local-normalized robust objective yields finite residuals and stable convergence on canonical EPI-like synthetic data with bias field and outlier voxels.
acceptance_criteria.test_hint: Randomized synthetic volumes with additive drift/outliers; assert finite costs and monotonic or near-monotonic reduction per level.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Pipeline performs one final resample; optimization uses trilinear only; final interpolation mode matches requested option.
acceptance_criteria.test_hint: Hook sampler call counters and interpolation mode flags.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Estimation path executes in coarse-grained C++ entrypoint without per-frame R looping.
acceptance_criteria.test_hint: Profile and inspect R wrapper; ensure single C++ call for estimation.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: QC output includes all required frame-level metrics and at least one derived censor recommendation flag.
acceptance_criteria.test_hint: Contract test for expected columns/fields and bitmask decoding.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Corrected output preserves input geometric metadata (affine orientation, voxel dimensions, time dimension) within exact or defined tolerance.
On identity-motion synthetic input, recovered motion parameters remain near zero and corrected output is nearly unchanged.
acceptance_criteria.test_hint: Set strict near-zero bounds for parameters and RMSE delta.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: On synthetic known rigid transforms, median parameter error meets baseline target.
acceptance_criteria.test_hint: Apply known framewise transforms to static template and compare recovered vs ground truth.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Restart mechanism triggers on intentionally perturbed bad initializations and improves final cost for a majority of triggered frames.
acceptance_criteria.test_hint: Inject poor initial poses and assert cost improvement after restart branch.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: rigid_spline mode accepts slice_times/mb_groups and produces packet-time-varying pose application in final resampling.
acceptance_criteria.test_hint: Assert pose evaluation times differ from volume center times when offsets are provided.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Spin-history repair runs as separate callable stage and is not required for successful rigid estimation/apply pipeline.
acceptance_criteria.test_hint: Independent function contract and integration smoke test.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Boundary handling with replicate padding avoids catastrophic edge artifacts on shifted volumes at FOV boundaries.
acceptance_criteria.test_hint: Translate synthetic volume near boundaries and compare zero vs replicate padding artifact metrics.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Runtime for representative dataset remains within target envelope on reference hardware.
acceptance_criteria.test_hint: Benchmark nt=300, 64x64x48 synthetic/real-like run with default control.
acceptance_criteria.notes: Reference machine spec must be versioned in benchmark config.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: FD and DVARS outputs are deterministic under fixed seed and unchanged code/dependency versions.
acceptance_criteria.test_hint: Re-run metrics on fixed fixture; compare numeric output with tolerance.

preconditions: Input must be 4D numeric array-like volume.
Mask dimensions must match spatial dimensions.
slice_times and mb_groups lengths must be valid for nz or packet count.
postconditions: All costs and QC metrics finite unless frame flagged invalid.
Output geometry metadata preserved on rebuild.
invariants: SE(3) update composition used for pose updates.
Single final resampling in standard path.
Warm-start temporal ordering from reference outward.

pr_fast: identity and synthetic shift smoke tests

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Reference bias from poor initial frame.
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Bootstrap alignment plus robust template rebuild and optional second refresh.
Temporal warm starts plus targeted tiny restart set and frame flags.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Over-smoothing from interpolation and repeated resampling.
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Trilinear during optimization and exactly one high-order final resample.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: False confidence from successful realignment despite residual artifacts.
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Expose QC flags, optional rigid_spline and optional spin-history repair.

risks_and_mitigations.risk: Performance regression from fragmented R/C++ calls.
risks_and_mitigations.mitigation: Use coarse-grained C++ entrypoints and benchmark guardrails.

done_when: AC-010 and expanded adversarial tests pass
spin-history repair stage integrated as optional module
AC-012 and related QC checks pass
